Tooltip_FlipThisCar_Desc: Heave the vehicle back onto its wheels.
Tooltip_FlipThisCar_ExitVehicle: Get out of the vehicle first.
Tooltip_FlipThisCar_Moving: The vehicle must be standing still.
Tooltip_FlipThisCar_TooWeak: I'm not strong enough to flip this.
